knight-lances.name: Knight Lances
knight-lances.text: One IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit in the Detachment becomes a CHARACTER and so can be a WARLORD if they are the Detachment's Commander. In addition, this unit has a Warmaster Trait, even if they are not your Warmaster (if the unit is your Warmaster, then they have two Warmaster Traits - re-roll any duplicate results when determining these).

ion-gauntlet-shield.name: Ion Gauntlet Shield
ion-gauntlet-shield.text: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by enemy SUPER-HEAVY units that target this unit.

mentor.name: Mentor
mentor.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly <HOUSEHOLD> ARMIGER CLASS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

chainbreaker.name: Chainbreaker
chainbreaker.text: Add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of friendly IMPERIUM units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

auto-sacristan-ritual-of-reloading.name: Auto-Sacristan: Ritual of Reloading
auto-sacristan-ritual-of-reloading.text: Weapons the selected unit is equipped with that have the One Use Only ability and have been used to make attacks this battle are considered not to have made those attacks for the purposes of the One Use Only ability.

auto-sacristan-ritual-of-refuelling.name: Auto-Sacristan: Ritual of Refuelling
auto-sacristan-ritual-of-refuelling.text: Add 3" to the selected unit’s Move characteristic until the end of the next turn.

auto-sacristan.name: Auto-Sacristan
auto-sacristan.text: At the start of the Damage phase, the player who set up this terrain feature can select one IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from their army within 1" of this terrain feature and choose one of the following effects:

auto-sacristan-ritual-of-repairing.name: Auto-Sacristan: Ritual of Repairing
auto-sacristan-ritual-of-repairing.text: Remove one damage marker from the selected unit.

unstable-reactor.name: Unstable Reactor
unstable-reactor.text: When this unit is destroyed, it explodes on a result of 8+.

empyreal-preysight.name: Empyreal Preysight
empyreal-preysight.text: This unit does not suffer the penalty for attacks made with ranged weapons that target obscured targets.

vehicle-squadron.name: Vehicle Squadron
vehicle-squadron.text: Each Lord of War slot in a Detachment allows you to take up to three of this unit in your army, instead of one. Each unit taken for a single Lord of War slot must be placed at the same time and within 6" of each other unit taken for the same slot the first time they are set up.

dual-plasma-core-explosion.name: Dual Plasma Core Explosion
dual-plasma-core-explosion.text: When this unit is destroyed, roll two D12 instead of one D12 to determine if it explodes, and it does so on any result of a 10+. When this unit explodes, place one blast marker next to every unit (excluding SUPER-HEAVY units) that is within 12" of this unit instead of 6".
